Type and class of param objects

Source: R/param.R
is_param.Rd

Test whether an object is a param and get the type of the value of a param.

Usage

is_param(x)

param_type(x)

Arguments

x

A param object (param_type() also accepts plain values).

Value

  • is_param(): TRUE or FALSE.

  • param_type(): the type of the value, one of

    • "character"

    • "factor" (also ordered factors)

    • "logical"

    • "numeric" (double and integer)

    • "list" (also param groups)

    • "data.frame"

    • or else the first class of the value, e.g. "Date".

Details

Functions

  • is_param() tests whether x is a param.

  • param_type() returns the type of the value of a param, e.g. "numeric" for a number. pubflow uses it to choose the input widget. (class() of a param is no help here, as it starts with "param".)

Examples

is_param(param(1))
#> [1] TRUE
is_param(1)
#> [1] FALSE

param_type(param(1L))
#> [1] "numeric"
param_type(choice_param("b", c("a", "b")))
#> [1] "factor"
param_type(param(Sys.Date()))
#> [1] "Date"
param_type(param_group(list(a = param("x"))))
#> [1] "list"
